title: Supply Chain Propagation of Textual Signals: LLM Embeddings and Cross-Sectional Return Predictability
abstract: arXiv:2606.29290v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper proposes a novel asset pricing framework that augments large language model (LLM) embeddings of annual report disclosures with supply chain knowledge graph (KG) propagation. Using FinBERT embeddings of 10-K MD&A sections for 255 S&P 500 firms over 2011-2025, two sets of return predictors are constructed: direct LLM embeddings and network-augmented embeddings, where firm-level signals propagate through inter-firm linkages. Fama-MacBeth cross-sectional regressions reveal that the network-augmented factor (net_pc_5) carries significant return predictability with a Newey-West t-statistic of -2.64, even after controlling for momentum, volatility, and firm size. A long-short portfolio sorted on net_pc_5 achieves an annualized Sharpe ratio of 0.86 and a Fama-French five-factor alpha of 7.27% per year (t = 2.30). The predictive power survives out-of-sample tests, placebo experiments, sector-neutralization, and subsample analysis.

translated_title: 文本信号的供应链传导：LLM嵌入与横截面收益可预测性
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种新颖的资产定价框架，将年报披露的大语言模型（LLM）嵌入与供应链知识图谱（KG）传播相结合。使用2011至2025年间255家标普500公司10-K年报“管理层讨论与分析”（MD&A）部分的FinBERT嵌入，构建了两组收益预测因子：直接LLM嵌入和网络增强嵌入，其中公司层面的信号通过公司间关联在网络中传播。Fama-MacBeth横截面回归显示，网络增强因子（net_pc_5）具有显著的收益预测能力，Newey-West t统计量为-2.64，即使在控制了动量、波动率和公司规模之后依然如此。基于net_pc_5排序的多空组合实现了0.86的年化夏普比率和每年7.27%的Fama-French五因子alpha（t = 2.30）。其预测能力通过了样本外测试、安慰剂实验、行业中性化以及子样本分析的检验。
tldr: 本文将年报文本的LLM嵌入通过供应链知识图谱在关联公司间传播，构建的网络增强文本因子具有显著横截面收益预测能力，对应多空组合年化夏普比率达0.86、五因子alpha达每年7.27%。
